title: Response tao coupon thanh cong co du field coupon bat buoc
preconditions: Admin da dang nhap; coupon code SCHEMA10 chua ton tai
expected_result: Response la JSON object chua coupon moi voi id, code, type, discount_value, min_order_amount, expired_at, max_uses_per_user; cac gia tri khop request.
notes: Spec khong dinh nghia schema chi tiet nen fields_checked duoc suy ra tu body va hanh vi tao resource.

title: Kieu du lieu response coupon dung voi spec
preconditions: Admin da dang nhap; coupon code SCHEMATYPE chua ton tai
expected_result: id, discount_value, min_order_amount, max_uses_per_user la number; code/type/expired_at la string; expired_at parse duoc theo date ISO.

title: Response tao coupon khong chua field ngoai schema
preconditions: Admin da dang nhap; coupon code NOSURPLUS chua ton tai
expected_result: Response khong co password, passwordHash, internalCost, sql, stack, token, refreshToken hoac field debug noi bo.
notes: Day la schema negative check: cac field nay khong duoc xuat hien.

title: Validation error khi thieu code co cau truc loi on dinh
preconditions: Admin da dang nhap va co JWT hop le
expected_result: Response loi la JSON co message hoac error.message mo ta field code bat buoc; khong tra HTML/plain stack trace.
notes: Spec khong chot error schema, chap nhan message hoac error.message nhung phai nhat quan.

title: Unauthorized error khi thieu token dung status va schema
expected_result: Response loi xac thuc la JSON, co message/error ro rang va khong xu ly body.

title: Forbidden error khi user thuong goi API admin dung status va schema
preconditions: Co JWT hop le cua role=user
expected_result: Response phan quyen la JSON, phan biet 403 voi 401 va co message/error khong tiet lo thong tin noi bo.

title: Response xoa coupon thanh cong co schema toi thieu nhat quan
preconditions: Admin da dang nhap; coupon id=401 ton tai
expected_result: Neu status 200 thi response JSON co message/id da xoa; neu 204 thi body rong. Khong tra coupon nhay cam hoac stack trace.
notes: Spec chi liet ke endpoint xoa, khong mo ta body; case nay kiem tra tinh nhat quan response.

title: Response xoa coupon khong ton tai tra 404 dung schema loi
preconditions: Admin da dang nhap; coupon id=999999 khong ton tai
expected_result: Response loi la JSON co message/error ro rang, khong tra HTML hoac stack trace.
